question: Show me stocks that dropped a lot lately but the company is actually fine — like still growing revenue and not overpriced. Kinda looking for a dip to buy.

tools_called.result_summary: Resolved: concept='revenue' (Total Revenue, income statement). Top match with curated=true.
Resolved: pattern='consecutive_growth' (revenue grew in every one of the last N years). Also found 'consecutive_growth_sharp' (>10%/yr every year) and 'accelerating' as alternatives.

Returned 60 (capped) stocks that dropped >=15% over last 60 days AND have consecutive 2-year revenue growth AND PE below sector average. Top hit: head_listing_id=602, RSI 41.6, gross_margin 43.8%, net_margin 14.5%, pe below cohort benchmark of 40.9. Multiple candidates combining technical pullback with fundamental health.
